scope: Direct visual inspection of the 19 assigned immutable page images, including the entire D76 proof and the named historical overflow displays; this is a layout review, not a new mathematical proof audit.
overall_visual_observations: All assigned pages were opened and their images emitted in batches of at most three. No clipped text, overlapping equations or tags, missing glyphs, misplaced footers, broken tables, or visibly excessive right margins were found. The repaired D37o, D74.1 and F19.9 displays and all D76 pages render clearly.
